steps: Measured ship identity, Fuel, Cargo and primary action fit all portrait widths; the taller scene may push content below the fold at 640–719px height.
Pause motion and reduced motion stop both orbit-ring halves and the docked port light.
Report and ship share the report; Fuel/Cargo deep links, explicit Done, Escape, native focus containment/return, browser Back/Forward and Menu verified.
Manual preview, exact approval, queued intent, real finite worker, confirmed persistence and activity navigation verified.

Pending/sending/uncertain/confirmed-with-review states block duplicates. Read-only reconciliation retains confirmed review. History retains all 95 synthetic commands across a 50-command polling update, refreshes older states and keeps older saved previews open.
Active-run approved limits and real Stop request retain Stop requested while ownership settles.
Arrival due remains Checking; presentation pause/resume and lifecycle events preserve deadlines and issue no gameplay writes; reduced motion disables animation.
Missing fields, zero-capacity fuel, long symbols, landscape/wide/enlarged text scrolling, no-ship and archive states verified.

herdArtBrowser.reason: Required spacetraders-map-90 Herd site is absent; no Herd configuration was changed.

notes: Tall docked/orbit artwork matches round 2 geometry; transit, arriving and unknown match round 1, adapting to actual scene width and real progress.
128px transit/arriving/unknown use the approved 80px location size; labels stay 112px wide so Observed location does not wrap outside the scene.
Orbit controls use a hull-height target (64px tall at K=4, 44px at K=2); the unchanged 128x96 or 64x48 artwork remains centred on the ring.
The 72px scene is a safety-only K=1 placeholder. Its fixed safe ship height does not preserve docking or route alignment; proper design is deferred.
Wide review sheets crop stationary scenes around the centre and proportionally reduce travelling scenes; full-page originals are authoritative.

inspectionAudit.definition: Unique project source/document/config files inspected, excluding dependencies, generated build output, evidence images/JSON and execution logs. Searches count rg and Select-String invocations.
